local limitBottom = workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize.Y - GuiService:GetGuiInset().Y - 6 -- the hotbar hides while a window is open
	-- don't cover the money / speed pills: if the window reaches over them sideways, stop above them
	local hud = player.PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("SpeedUI")
	local pills = hud and hud:FindFirstChild("Holder")
	if pills and win.AbsolutePosition.X < pills.AbsolutePosition.X + pills.AbsoluteSize.X and pills.AbsolutePosition.Y > top then
		limitBottom = math.min(limitBottom, pills.AbsolutePosition.Y - 6)
	end
	-- first slide up (as far as the top allows), then shrink if it still doesn't fit
	local over = top + h - limitBottom
	local shift = 0
	if over > 0 then shift = math.min(over, math.max(0, top - limitTop)) end
	win.Position = basePos - UDim2.fromOffset(0, shift)
	top -= shift
	local centre = top + h / 2
	local k = math.min(1, (limitBottom - centre) * 2 / h, (centre - limitTop) * 2 / h)
	return math.max(k, 0.5)
end
edits.new_string:
local screenBottom = workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize.Y - GuiService:GetGuiInset().Y - 6 -- the hotbar hides while a window is open
	local limitBottom = screenBottom
	-- don't cover the money / speed pills: if the window reaches over them sideways, stop above them
	-- (2026-10-22 UI polish, M5 / M10) ... or, when that keeps it bigger, get just narrow enough to clear them sideways: a
	-- wide window (Shop, Index) used to be shrunk all the way above the pills (the Shop came out at 0.61 of the screen)
	local hud = player.PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("SpeedUI")
	local pills = hud and hud:FindFirstChild("Holder")
	local kSide
	if pills and win.AbsolutePosition.X < pills.AbsolutePosition.X + pills.AbsoluteSize.X and pills.AbsolutePosition.Y > top then
		limitBottom = math.min(limitBottom, pills.AbsolutePosition.Y - 6)
		local w = win.AbsoluteSize.X
		if w > 0 then kSide = (win.AbsolutePosition.X + w / 2 - (pills.AbsolutePosition.X + pills.AbsoluteSize.X + 6)) * 2 / w end
	end
	-- first slide up (as far as the top allows), then shrink if it still doesn't fit
	local function fitTo(lb)
		local over = top + h - lb
		local shift = 0
		if over > 0 then shift = math.min(over, math.max(0, top - limitTop)) end
		local centre = top - shift + h / 2
		return math.min(1, (lb - centre) * 2 / h, (centre - limitTop) * 2 / h), shift
	end
	local k, shift = fitTo(limitBottom)
	if kSide and kSide > k then
		local k2, shift2 = fitTo(screenBottom)
		k2 = math.min(k2, kSide)
		if k2 > k then k, shift = k2, shift2 end
	end
	win.Position = basePos - UDim2.fromOffset(0, shift)
	return math.max(k, 0.5)
end
